ci_support_linux_64_.yaml:
DOCKER_PLATFORM:
- linux/amd64
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
ffmpeg:
- '9'
python_min:
- '3.11'

about.description:
A utility for batch-normalizing audio using ffmpeg.
This program normalizes media files to a certain loudness level using the
EBU R128 loudness normalization procedure. It can also perform RMS-based
normalization (where the mean is lifted or attenuated), or peak
normalization to a certain target level.
An external installation of ffmpeg is reuqired.

name: ffmpeg-normalize
raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "ffmpeg-normalize" %}
{% set version = "1.45.1" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/slhck/ffmpeg-normalize/archive/refs/tags/v{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 7eb28d9c4b69a3e42dcc3d162728c4a437145cbd423cdda60655d846275ff21f

build:
  noarch: python
  number: 0
  script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv
  entry_points:
    - ffmpeg-normalize = ffmpeg_normalize.__main__:main

requirements:
  host:
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - pip
    - uv-build >=0.8.14,<1.0.0
  run:
    - python >={{ python_min }}
    - ffmpeg-progress-yield >=1.0.1
    - mutagen >=1.47.0
    - rich >=13.7.0
    - rich-argparse >=1.5.0

test:
  imports:
    - ffmpeg_normalize
  requires:
    - pip
    - python {{ python_min }}
  commands:
    - pip check
    - ffmpeg-normalize -h

about:
  home: https://github.com/slhck/ffmpeg-normalize
  license: MIT
  license_family: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE.md
  summary: Audio Normalization for Python/ffmpeg
  description: |
    A utility for batch-normalizing audio using ffmpeg.
    This program normalizes media files to a certain loudness level using the
    EBU R128 loudness normalization procedure. It can also perform RMS-based
    normalization (where the mean is lifted or attenuated), or peak
    normalization to a certain target level.
    An external installation of ffmpeg is reuqired.
  doc_url: https://github.com/slhck/ffmpeg-normalize/blob/master/README.md
  dev_url: https://github.com/slhck/ffmpeg-normalize/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - slhck
